dogecoin.text:
Summary 

Dogecoin = the OG, simple, fun, liquid.

Shiba Inu = utility & DeFi/NFT ecosystem.

Pepe = pure meme hype.

👉 Different vibes, same meme energy. #Crypto #MemeCoins #Blockchain

— End 🧵

Market Standing (2024)

#Dogecoin: Most liquid + oldest community.

#ShibaInu: Ambitious ecosystem growth.

#Pepe: Rapid hype cycles, but volatile.

Supply & Tokenomics

Dogecoin: Unlimited supply, ~5B DOGE added yearly.

Shiba Inu: 1 quadrillion minted, but massive burns over time. 🔥

Pepe: Fixed supply, smaller cap.

Utility

Dogecoin: Mostly tipping + micro-transactions, simple & fun.

Shiba Inu: Ecosystem with #DeFi, NFTs, ShibaSwap, and #Shibarium (Layer 2).

Pepe: No real utility yet → purely speculative.

Origins

#Dogecoin: Born in 2013 as a joke → now the OG meme coin.

#ShibaInu: Launched in 2020 as the “Dogecoin killer.”

#Pepe: Newcomer in 2023, inspired by internet meme culture.

🧵 Dogecoin vs Meme Coins

Everyone knows #Dogecoin 🐶… but how does it really stack up against other meme coins like #ShibaInu & #Pepe? Let’s break it down 👇
